tasks.label: Build DreamyMusic.plugin (Release)
tasks.detail: Compiles Universal (arm64 + x86_64) After Effects plugin bundle via Xcode

tasks.label: Build DreamyMusic.plugin (Debug)
tasks.detail: Compiles Debug After Effects plugin bundle via Xcode

tasks.label: Install Plugin to Adobe After Effects MediaCore
tasks.command: sudo rm -rf "/Library/Application Support/Adobe/Common/Plug-ins/7.0/MediaCore/DreamyMusic.plugin" && sudo cp -R "${workspaceFolder}/build/Release/DreamyMusic.plugin" "/Library/Application Support/Adobe/Common/Plug-ins/7.0/MediaCore/" && sudo chown -R $(whoami):admin "/Library/Application Support/Adobe/Common/Plug-ins/7.0/MediaCore/DreamyMusic.plugin"
tasks.detail: Copies built DreamyMusic.plugin to Adobe MediaCore shared Plug-ins directory
